sources.name: Frozen development cohort
sources.role: Primary 2024 presence-background training and spatial development
sources.limitation: Target-group background locations are not confirmed absences; records reflect uneven observer effort.

sources.name: Mosquito Alert 2024 candidate subset
sources.role: Exploratory presence-only candidate; not used for training
sources.limitation: The selected 2024 subset lacks numeric location uncertainty and requires cross-provider deduplication; not independent validation.

sources.name: GLOBE Observer mosquito-habitat reports
sources.role: Auxiliary habitat observations; not species-presence labels
sources.limitation: Habitat observations do not establish Aedes albopictus presence; species claims in this archive are not expert-verified.

sources.name: NEON 2026 external survey diagnostic
sources.role: Temporal survey diagnostic; not used for training or model selection
sources.limitation: United States surveillance with method- and year-specific labels; previously examined and not a blind global validation.

sources.name: GBIF 2024 occurrence screen
sources.role: Source audit; records overlap the existing archive
sources.limitation: The precision-screened 2024 records were already present in the local archive; do not count them as new independent sites.

sources.name: GBIF 2026 occurrence screen
sources.role: Reserved presence-only candidate; not used for training
sources.limitation: No DOI-frozen download snapshot; presence-only records are not surveyed absences or independent validation.

abundance.reason: Available trap/count sources differ in effort, season, life stage, and spatial support; no harmonized globally dense target is available.
